verdict.rationale: The pack shows only a bare 'n8n API' docs page title (n8n-docs-16). Nothing says that API can create, update or activate workflows, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. An API merely existing is not documented evidence of this capability, so the story is applicable but unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create, update, and activate a workflow programmatically through the public API
